protocol.policy: Learn the incremental gross freight return from buying a current six-sample demand reading versus skipping, conditional on one remaining truck slot and public freight history. Compare that value with the posted price. The specialist skips with zero or two slots. The independent Bayesian planner has unrestricted use of the same survey.
protocol.markets: Six positive tariffs and the free control share every freight and potential reading draw. Fresh schedules have four previously unseen paired openings per stratum, balanced across wave-six signals aligned with and contrary to the closing market. Preserve original interrupted drop and archive earlier Tariff schedules on independent seeds.
protocol.fitting: Separate training banks for one-slot freight continuation, buy-minus-skip calibration and train-only selection. At training only, integrate possible survey readings and future signed outcomes using the simulator. Selection uses only training families and training seeds. Select reward weight profile and opening from a fixed grid with maximin slack, then mean slack then fixed order. Always publish seed 13.
protocol.primary: On fresh hot-ending interrupted drops and on fresh cold-ending reversals separately, average fee-adjusted full-shift differences equally across the six positive prices. Within EACH group require lower paired 95% bounds greater than zero against BOTH (1) the same specialist forced to skip and (2) the independently acting fee-aware Bayesian planner. All trajectories share freight draws. Report free and all-price controls separately.
protocol.retention: On exact original interrupted drops across the seven prices, require positive lower bounds vs the historical stochastic planner, Booking and Survey. Require lower bounds above minus one credit vs each of Tariff, Paid, Rally, Trust, Drift and Turns. Show the independent current planner separately.
protocol.matched: Secondary controlled one-slot comparison. Run the frozen prior Tariff opener through wave five at each fee. When it has exactly one slot, clone its identical balance, signed history, tariff and unrevealed survey state to the specialist, forced-skip specialist and planner. Their full net includes the identical earlier freight. Include all eligible cases regardless of buy. Publish positive-fee results by target and counts on the specialist's own trajectories.
protocol.uncertainty: Resample whole seeds with all siblings and prices together, 2,000 paired bootstrap draws. Intervals apply to these fixed schedules and release checkpoint. The joint conclusion requires all four superiority bounds and original retention. Secondary cohorts, per-price results and other training seeds do not select the published model.
